title: Opening and Roger Mitchell's address near the San Jacinto site
summary: Tape begins on 19 January 1972 with confirmation of Mitchell's address, a block from where San Jacinto Hall stood.

blocks.x: 18 1972. Can you hear me? You can hear me? Yes. Now, what's this address right now?
Yeah, 1519 and a half domain. Next block from where the San Jacinto was.
This is the next block from where the San Jacinto Hall was? Yeah, it's right.
Yeah, because see, I moved to New Orleans after they tore the San Jacinto down. Yeah.
